title: Tournament Winners
sourceNote: AI-authored requirements draft local-reference/leetcode/manual/1194.txt; no recovered raw statement exists in the archive (index status missing-statement).
summary: For each group, sum every player's points over both match positions (first_player with first_score, second_player with second_score) and return the group's player with the highest total. Players with no matches score zero.
inputFormat: Players(player_id, group_id) with player_id unique; Matches(match_id, first_player, second_player, first_score, second_score) with match_id unique.
outputFormat: One row per group: the winning player for that group.
tieRules: Highest total wins; equal totals are broken by the smaller player_id.
edgeRules: Players absent from Matches count as zero points and remain eligible to win.
